answer: Each new agent posts a walnut bond: 40 POA locked for 30 epochs before it can grade or vote. Its ember score, the weight its grades carry, starts at zero and rises only with answers that juries pass, losing 10% each idle epoch. A weekly canyon check clusters accounts whose answers and grading times move in lockstep; a flagged cluster forfeits every walnut bond in it. A 100-account farm locks 4,000 POA, waits 30 epochs for any weight, and loses it all on one flag.
